[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” custom_margin=”||25px|||” text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

– The Kenwood multi-view camera is equipped with an advanced image processor that is capable of altering viewing angles and increasing the number of viewing options including corner views and adding graphic guidelines to the camera image.  The camera also has the ability to mirror its image, enabling it to be used as a front or rear view camera. Easily switch between the many viewing options using the touch screen from a compatible KENWOOD receiver, or using the included multi-function switch when not connected to a compatible KENWOOD receiver.
